findings.location: content.body.steps[s3].blocks[2].text: «estar + gerundio (форма на -ando / -iendo) зі звичною дією підкреслює, що ситуація тимчасова»
findings.description: This categorically equates habitual progressive uses with temporariness. The construction can also describe an action regularly in progress at a recurring time, without implying a temporary routine.
findings.suggestion: Say that the progressive can emphasize a temporary current routine. Retain the simple present as the neutral choice for permanent habits without making temporariness obligatory in every habitual progressive.

sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, discussion of estar + gerundio and habitual or iterative interpretations (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[1].text: «Після голосної основи — -yendo: leer → leyendo, oír → oyendo.»
findings.description: The rule does not restrict its scope to the relevant -er/-ir verbs. A vowel-final stem alone does not select -yendo: estudiar has estudiando, already explicitly taught in this case.
findings.suggestion: Use a narrowly accurate reminder: «Форми gerundio: leer → leyendo, oír → oyendo.» Alternatively, explain the relevant -er/-ir pattern while distinguishing -ar → -ando.

sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 4, verbal inflection and gerund formation (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[1].text: «Після голосної основи — -yendo: leer → leyendo, oír → oyendo.»
findings.description: The unrestricted vowel-stem rule incorrectly includes -ar verbs such as estudiar, whose gerund is estudiando. The examples are correct, but the stated generalization is too broad.
findings.suggestion: Use «Форми gerundio: leer → leyendo, oír → oyendo», or explicitly delimit the relevant -er/-ir pattern and distinguish -ar → -ando.

sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 4, verbal inflection and gerund formation (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: «Ідеться про звичайну годину вечері в родині. Оберіть форму.»; task.options[b]: «estamos cenando», graded incorrect.
findings.description: The prompt does not distinguish stating the habitual meal time from describing dinner as regularly in progress at nine. Both readings concern the family's usual dinner time. The feedback identifies the second reading but the prompt does not exclude it.
findings.suggestion: Specify whether the learner must state the usual meal time without an in-progress perspective or describe what is underway at nine. Grade the options according to that clarified intention.

items.reviewerAnswer: a for stating the usual dinner time; b also fits a reading in which dinner is routinely in progress at nine.
sources: Packet, task.options[b].feedbackUk: «о дев’ятій вечеря вже триває».
